question: Should maintainers rebase and land this operation-local reply-operation marker as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76831, or require live WhatsApp media proof before merge?
rationale: The source-level fix shape is strong, but the PR is currently conflicting and changes user-visible delivery modality, so merge timing and proof expectations need maintainer intent.

options.title: Rebase And Land Operation-Local Fix

options.title: Pause If State Boundary Is Not Accepted
